main.description: An organization's self-published profile: who it is and what it does. Published in the organization's own repo, so an AppView learns the cast from the network rather than from a table it shipped. Nothing here is committed to by any release — it is descriptive, self-asserted, and not part of the 8130 field set. SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION DATA — every organization, CAGE code and certificate here is fictional.

kind.description: What role this organization plays. Self-asserted: nobody validates it, and an AppView is free to disagree.

synthetic.description: Required marker. This record set exists to demonstrate a protocol, not to describe real companies.

cage.description: Fictional commercial identifier. Deliberately formatted so it cannot collide with a real five-character CAGE code.

certificate.description: Fictional repair-station certificate number, where the kind implies one.
